production_invariants.statement: People is collaboration; Together is runtime networking and their identities/actions are not interchangeable.
Collaboration relay/storage failure cannot replace or discard the current local authored project.
Authenticated relay input is bounded before materialization and permission epoch remains a separate semantic authorization check.
Presence/cursors/selections are transient and absent after collaboration-store reopen.
Conflict inspection exposes stable semantic loci and resolution publishes a later causal transaction.
Protected Asset resolution selects one complete immutable revision alternative; field-wise mixing is impossible.
Unsupported collaboration history remains recoverable quarantine until a deterministic migration exists.
